facts: Parties: Galloway Industries Ltd (Customer) and Eskdale Energy plc (Supplier).

Clause 3.2: this Agreement expires on 4 November 2026 and renews automatically for successive 2-year terms unless either party gives notice of non-renewal at least 60 days before expiry. Notices are effective only on Business Days (Monday to Friday).
